fixture.read_time: fixed first twelve minutes of 96 minutes
fixture.natural_merge: enabled, not stopped or OPTIMIZE forced

protocol: Two independent GitHub Ubuntu runners. Each fresh-server A/B/B/A phase receives exactly 84 fixed-time INSERTs and 40 native requests at absolute clock deadlines, with exact source binary and 96-batch fixture SHA, full label/timestamp/float native oracle, per-query physical and QueryFinish controls. Schedule max late <=75ms and progress <=2 batches; no QueryResultCache. Within-runner compare candidate mean B1/B2 against control mean A0/A3; require p95 and mixed process CPU candidate improvement exceed max(5%, local A/A drift). Do not compare absolute latency between host machines.

negative_evidence.reason: Initial independent fixed-rate ABBA valid native responses and schedules but LC p95 A/A drift 26.30% exceeded 25% preregistered threshold. It was excluded without modification of drift threshold or traffic cadence.

limitations: Two independent GitHub-hosted runners, one 96-batch synthetic high churn workload; this cannot support a general production hardware/SLA guarantee.
Read query fixed to first 12 batches and one evaluation time; the 14d/1.33m broad Grafana workload and multi-tenant ACL semantics are different.
Mixed CPU includes writer, native reader and natural background merges; read-path causal operator attribution not isolated.
Optimized ClickHouse O2+jemalloc production-like build and matched VictoriaMetrics under identical hardware/cgroups have not been tested here.
Open-loop means one in-flight reader; queueing under many concurrent client sockets remains a separate workload.
Fixed offered wall rate is identical for both variants, so a near-unity total-window wall ratio is a design outcome, not a test of write latency.

next_action.step: Validate CPU/RSS/operator bottlenecks of RAW UUID under fixed arrivals using production-like optimized ClickHouse when the existing jemalloc build becomes ready; separately compare larger 14d windows and 1/4/8 clients before release approval. No duplicate source compilation.
next_action.stop_condition: Do not promote global Raw UUID default; opt-in for high churn only. Stop if native parity, memory cap, relative p95 or background merge cost regress in heldout configuration.
